summary: Aurora Mobile filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 unaudited results and a separate exhibit announcing a share repurchase program of up to US$10 million. Quarterly revenue was RMB106.5 million (US$15.9 million), up 17% year over year, with net income of RMB4.5 million and adjusted EBITDA of RMB6.3 million. The repurchase authorization is a capital-return announcement rather than a tender offer or special situation; no price per share, premium, or fixed timetable was disclosed. Routine earnings disclosure dominates.
